name: mPainter (Early Access Alpha)
summary: Open-source layer-based 3D texture painting app by Mattias Lind: Qt workspace with Blender rendering in-process, layers/masks, texture sets and UDIMs, import of Blender materials, Material Presets and Mask Generators, editable .blend projects. Early Access Alpha; Linux is the locally tested platform.

access.price: $0 build from source; Early Access Alpha ready-made builds $15 on Gumroad
access.notes: GPL-3.0 copyleft applies if you distribute modified builds. README: Linux tested; Windows CI prepared but unverified; macOS native viewport not claimed working yet. Alpha software.

procedure: For ready builds: buy/download the Early Access Alpha from https://mattiaslind.gumroad.com/l/mpainter
Or clone https://github.com/mattiaslind93/mpainter and follow docs/building.md
Launch mPainter; import textures or Blender materials; paint with layers/masks; save as .blend
